 Advocate.

Counsel for the Respondent : Mr. P.C. Petshali,
no. 2/informant/victim Advocate Hon'ble Alok Kumar Verma,J.
Present Application under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 has been filed to quash the charge-sheet dated 28.12.2020, cognizance order dated 07.04.2021 and the entire proceedings of Criminal Case No. 1530 of 2021, "State vs. Neelu Agarwal and two others", pending before the Court of Judicial Magistrate/Ist Additional Civil Judge (Junior Division), Kashipur,
District Udham Singh Nagar under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860,
Section 3 and Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.
2.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The applicant no. 1 is the mother and the applicant no. 2 is the father of the applicant no. 3.

All the three applicants are identified by Mr.
Kaushal Sah Jagati, Advocate.
3. Smt. Charu Agarwal, the respondent no. 2, is present in-person.

She is identified by Mr. P.C.
Petshali, Advocate.

4. The applicants and respondent no. 2 submitted that there were matrimonial disputes between them and they have resolved their disputes and after resolving their disputes, they have filed a Compromise Application today.
5. Compounding application and affidavits of parties are on record.
6. Both the parties submitted that they have filed the Compounding Application and the Compromise Application with their free will and without any pressure.
They have requested to decide the present matter on the basis of compromise.

7. Learned counsel for the State submitted that there were matrimonial disputes between the parties and they have resolved their disputes, therefore, the State has no objection to the Compounding and Compromise Applications.
8.
The Compromise Application, filed today, is verified.

9. Keeping in view of the totality of the facts and circumstances of the case, this Court is of the view that ends of justice would be met, if the charge-sheet dated 28.12.2020, cognizance order dated 07.04.2021 and the entire proceedings of Criminal Case No. 1530 of 2021, pending before the Court of Judicial Magistrate/Ist Additional Civil Judge (Junior Division), Kashipur, District Udham Singh Nagar, are quashed.

entities.label: COURT

Resultantly, the charge-sheet dated 28.12.2020, cognizance order dated 07.04.2021 and the entire proceedings of Criminal Case No. 1530 of 2021, pending before the Court of Judicial Magistrate/Ist Additional Civil Judge (Junior Division), Kashipur, District Udham Singh Nagar, are hereby quashed.
